page.layout: One column of running text, top to bottom. Below the text, a printer's ornament (woodcut tailpiece, no text). At the bottom right, the catchword. Page number and running head at the top.

main_text.p: quomodo inquam ab illa tantus ignis repercutitur ut fiat visio? Ecce tertio causam repetimus. Ignis ille multus quidem, sed propter nimiam pororum laxitatem non impetu exiliens nec longam faciens jaculationem, ab igne objecti quem excitat facile repercutitur.

Possemus tamen dicere, id quod non fuerit a ratione alienum, nocte quamvis tenebrosa eos reii-gniculos nonnihil agere, ut radium oculi valde debilem possint sustinere ac repellere; Lumenque quod eos igniculos potentiores reddat, esse necessarium duntaxat illis animantibus, quorum radii fortiores majorem in objecto voluntresistentiam.

Id inquam forte possit propter aliqua animantia non absre dici. Non tamen videtur feli congruere, cujus oculorum nocturnus fulgor satis prae se fert causam quae rem videndam lumine necessario impertiat, ut dictum est.

page.notes: The ornament below the text is a printer's decoration with no printed words, so it is not transcribed. The catchword "M E-" is at the lower right. Doubtful readings: "reii-gniculos" (line-end hyphen, word uncertain); "absre" (may be a broken or misprinted word); "volunt" followed by "resistentiam" is run together in the scan, so the join is uncertain; "visio?" has a mark after it that may be punctuation or a reference sign. Spacing in "ignis repercutitur" and "prae se" is irregular in the print.
